description: Use for 'find remote data engineer jobs', 'nursing jobs in Germany', 'what is new in marketing this week'. Searches the WHOLE live job pool (about two million open jobs), not only the person's matches, and needs no CV. Words must all appear in the title, employer or description. Filters: remote only, a two-letter country code, jobs found within N days. Newest first. Each job has a pool_job_id; jobs that also have a page on keywordise.com/jobs carry a public_id. To apply, call apply_to_public_job (public_id) or apply_to_live_job (pool_job_id). For jobs ranked against this person's CV use list_matching_jobs instead.

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. DE, US, GB (list_countries_with_jobs).

query.description: Words such as 'data engineer' or 'python kubernetes'.

name: search_live_jobs
title: Search every live job
